units.text: INT. DOLLHOUSE - CONTINUOUS
That’s right. Well, we will share it, Nora, as man and wife should. That is how it shall be.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Caressing her.

Are you content now? There! There!—not these frightened dove’s eyes! The whole thing is only the wildest fancy!—Now, you must go and play through the Tarantella and practise with your tambourine. I shall go into the inner office and shut the door, and I shall hear nothing; you can make as much noise as you please.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Turns back at the door.
And when Rank comes, tell him where he will find me.
units.name: HELMER

units.text: Nods to her, takes his papers and goes into his room, and shuts the door after him.
bewildered with anxiety, stands as if rooted to the spot, and whispers.
. He was capable of doing it. He will do it. He will do it in spite of everything.—No, not that! Never, never! Anything rather than that! Oh, for some help, some way out of it!
units.name: NORA

units.text: The door-bell rings.
Doctor Rank! Anything rather than that—anything, whatever it is!
units.name: NORA

units.text: She puts her hands over her face, pulls herself together, goes to the door and opens it.
RANK is standing without, hanging up his coat.
During the following dialogue it begins to grow dark.
Good day, Doctor Rank. I knew your ring. But you mustn’t go in to Torvald now; I think he is busy with something.
units.name: NORA

units.text: And you?
units.name: RANK

units.text: brings him in and shuts the door after him.
. Oh, you know very well I always have time for you.
units.name: NORA

units.text: Thank you. I shall make use of as much of it as I can.
units.name: RANK

units.text: What do you mean by that? As much of it as you can?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Well, does that alarm you?
units.name: RANK

units.text: It was such a strange way of putting it. Is anything likely to happen?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Nothing but what I have long been prepared for. But I certainly didn’t expect it to happen so soon.
units.name: RANK

units.text: gripping him by the arm.
. What have you found out? Doctor Rank, you must tell me.
units.name: NORA

units.text: sitting down by the stove.
. It is all up with me. And it can’t be helped.
units.name: RANK

units.text: with a sigh of relief.
. Is it about yourself?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Who else? It is no use lying to one’s self. I am the most wretched of all my patients, Mrs Helmer. Lately I have been taking stock of my internal economy. Bankrupt! Probably within a month I shall lie rotting in the churchyard.
units.name: RANK

units.text: What an ugly thing to say!
units.name: NORA

units.text: The thing itself is cursedly ugly, and the worst of it is that I shall have to face so much more that is ugly before that. I shall only make one more examination of myself; when I have done that, I shall know pretty certainly when it will be that the horrors of dissolution will begin. There is something I want to tell you. Helmer’s refined nature gives him an unconquerable disgust at everything that is ugly; I won’t have him in my sick-room.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Oh, but, Doctor Rank—
units.name: NORA

units.text: I won’t have him there. Not on any account. I bar my door to him. As soon as I am quite certain that the worst has come, I shall send you my card with a black cross on it, and then you will know that the loathsome end has begun.
units.name: RANK

units.text: You are quite absurd today. And I wanted you so much to be in a really good humour.
units.name: NORA

units.text: With death stalking beside me?—To have to pay this penalty for another man’s sin? Is there any justice in that? And in every single family, in one way or another, some such inexorable retribution is being exacted—
units.name: RANK

units.text: putting her hands over her ears.
. Rubbish! Do talk of something cheerful.
units.name: NORA

units.text: Oh, it’s a mere laughing matter, the whole thing. My poor innocent spine has to suffer for my father’s youthful amusements.
units.name: RANK

units.text: sitting at the table on the left.
. I suppose you mean that he was too partial to asparagus and pate de foie gras, don’t you?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Yes, and to truffles.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Truffles, yes. And oysters too, I suppose?
units.name: NORA

units.text: Oysters, of course, that goes without saying.
units.name: RANK

units.text: And heaps of port and champagne. It is sad that all these nice things should take their revenge on our bones.
units.name: NORA

units.text: Especially that they should revenge themselves on the unlucky bones of those who have not had the satisfaction of enjoying them.
units.name: RANK

units.text: Yes, that’s the saddest part of it all.
units.name: NORA

units.text: with a searching look at her.
